verdict.rationale: The product's own fixed, built-in automations run in the background: a user-configured Gusto integration syncs hiring and equity data and automatically grants equity from offer-letter promises, and the automated data room collects documents behind the scenes as changes are made. There is no evidence of a user-defined automation builder, triggers, schedules, or agentic background tasks; documented workflows are manual and user-initiated. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or rule builder, scheduled or triggered background jobs, API or programmatic automation (OpenAPI probes returned 404), independent corroboration.
